assertions_strengthened: _merge_usage's first-wins rule covers four fields; the test asserted one, so three directions could be mutated to last-wins undetected. It now asserts all four, and adds a control that a later nonzero value does not overwrite either.
test_a_boolean_http_status_is_not_read_as_a_status asserted inside `if failure is not None`, so one of the two routes ran zero assertions. Both are now asserted directly.
test_a_capture_with_no_usable_frames_is_refused asserted only that a failure occurred; four different branches satisfy that. The kind and the detail are now pinned.
A chunk-classification test claimed StreamEventKind.USAGE in its name and docstring but asserted neither kind; it is split into two that each assert the kind they name.
A dead `if False else None` / `del snapshot` scaffold was removed from test_duplicate_catalog_aliases_are_rejected, where it could have hidden a deleted assertion.
read_terminated's numeric rule was only exercised in its negative direction; both halves are now tested.

defects_found_by_review_7: CRITICAL: map_finish_reason called .lower() on whatever it was given, so a non-string finish_reason raised AttributeError out of ZenAdapter.complete(). The streamed path already guarded this, so the two routes disagreed on the same capture and one of them died.
CRITICAL: ZenAdapter.stream constructed FailureKind from the capture's recorded kind directly, so a kind the project does not model raised ValueError. complete() already routed it through a mapper.

HIGH: the fixture route constructed FailureKind the same way, so an unknown recorded kind raised out of both fixture paths. RecordedExchange only checks that a kind is named, not that it is one this vocabulary defines.

MAJOR: ZenAdapter.stream substituted a hardcoded all-False capability placeholder when the caller passed none, so it reported `stream` as unsupported with the reason 'the endpoint's catalog does not advertise streaming' while having read no catalog -- and while accepting the stream. Capabilities now come from the catalog the adapter discovered, and an absent catalog supports no claim in either direction.
read_terminated accepted any non-zero number, so a sentinel field of -1 or 0.5 read as a completed stream. Only a real boolean or a documented spelling counts now.
defects_found_by_review_8: FixtureTransport.discover raised ValidationError on a duplicate-alias catalog while the Zen route deduped keep-first, so one payload produced two different snapshots. Fixed: fixture discovery keeps the first occurrence, mirroring Zen; the CatalogSnapshot schema guard is unchanged.

RecordedExchange.http_status coerced True to 1 on the fixture route while Zen reads any boolean as no status, inventing a status code the transcript never contained. Fixed: a mode=before validator rejects booleans on the fixture route.
RecordedExchange.retry_after_seconds coerced True to 1.0 on the fixture route while Zen returns None, inventing a retry delay. Fixed by the same validator.
harness_changes: All 74 mutation labels are now contiguous 1..74; earlier numbering had gaps that would have looked like a missing mutation.
Anchors are verified against the source before the run and reported as STALE ANCHORS, so a stale harness cannot quietly change what is measured.
Bytecode caching is disabled for every mutation run: a cached .pyc whose size and mtime matched the mutated source made two mutations invisible and reported them as survivors.
Restoration is armed at exit and on SIGINT/SIGTERM, so an interrupted run cannot leave a mutated module in the tree.
Round-8 re-run on the final tree: all 74 anchors still match, all 74 mutations caught, no skips. M75/M76 verified manually the same day (guard removed -> dedicated test fails -> guard restored).
live_readiness: blocked_external: no credentials, no spending authorization, no container runtime probed

supersede_reason: This record supersedes the eight earlier G03 attempts, all retained unchanged. An eighth independent review found three demonstrated defects, all the known shape -- a guard present on the Zen route and missing on the fixture route (duplicate-alias discovery, boolean http_status, boolean retry_after_seconds). All are fixed with dedicated regression tests. The adapter layer measures 100% statement and 100% branch coverage (961 statements, 358 branches), the full 74-mutation harness passes on the final tree, and M75/M76 pin the new guards. Independent review round 8 returns PASS.
